name: semantic_contrast_v0_3_lite_approach_vs_static_paired_eval
description: Held-out v0.3-lite paired contrast for unchanged scene position versus another entity moving into the scene.

items.text: A person stands near a library entrance. A book cart remains beside the doorway.
Someone waits by a ferry railing. A service cart remains near the bench.
A person pauses near a hotel desk. A suitcase remains beside the column.
Someone stands near a market stall. A crate remains beside the awning.
A person waits near a theater door. A cleaning cart remains beside the wall.
A person stands near a library entrance. A book cart rolls toward the doorway.
Someone waits by a ferry railing. A service cart rolls along the bench.
A person pauses near a hotel desk. A suitcase rolls out from beside the column.
Someone stands near a market stall. A crate slides out from beside the awning.
A person waits near a theater door. A cleaning cart rolls along the wall.
